# Project Showcase & Income Engine

**This site: every project auto-turned into a published write-up, résumé update, and income channel.**

The engine behind this portfolio: a project registry drives automatic write-ups, screenshots, and a self-updating résumé, then syndicates them across publishing platforms and feeds a scored job/client pipeline. If you're reading this, it's working.

## Highlights
- Registry-driven site generation
- Daily refresh + multi-platform syndication
- Résumé regenerated from real project data

## Stack
Node.js, GitHub Pages, Dev.to API, Hashnode API

## Live project
See the write-up, screenshots, and demo at https://sport.taila73942.ts.net/portfolio/project/project-showcase-engine.html
